messages:
Anika (People Ops): Hey everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Posting notes we promised on compensation bands, promotion calibration timing, and the bonus cadence. Ask questions here and I'll update the doc/live notes.

Tyler (Eng): thanks — quick first q: are we changing comp bands for US vs EMEA this cycle? heard rumors re: market adjustments.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): short answer: market adjustment is targeted to US bands this quarter. EMEA review is scheduled for next fiscal. Any global moves will be communicated before offers/merits go out.

Dmitri (EM): can you confirm promotion calibration date? managers need the window to finalize calibration packets.

Anika (People Ops): calibration meeting for promotions = May 15-16. Final manager submissions due May 8. We're keeping the same workflow: packet, manager rec, skip-level signoff, calibration panel.

Alice (IC4): what about retroactive promotions? i.e., if someone missed submitting in time but the manager has documentation.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): retro promos: approved only in exceptional cases and require Exec Sponsor + People Ops sign-off. We prefer rolling updates but not retro pay except in rare cases.

Tyler (Eng): any change to bonus timing? Last year payout drifted into Q3 and that caused confusion.

Anika (People Ops): good point — aiming to keep bonus payouts within Q2 this year. Target payout window: June 15 - June 30. If there are delays we'll post status in #people-ops and email managers.

Dmitri (EM): is there guidance for leveling parity across teams? some managers are nervous about inconsistent expectations between product and infra.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): leveling rubric is unchanged but we're publishing an expanded leveling guide (examples per ladder, cross-team expectations) next week. Managers should use rubric + evidence. If you need calibration help, ping People Ops.

Alice (IC4): will salary increases be tied to performance only, or is there a merit + market component?

Anika (People Ops): both. Merits reflect performance; market adjustments are separate and applied where bands are below market. We try to avoid double-counting.

Tyler (Eng): is there an appeal process if someone disagrees with leveling?

Maria (Comp & Benefits): yes — appeals open for 14 days after manager conversation. Submit using the form in the compensation doc, include manager notes + evidence. Appeals reviewed by a small committee (People Ops + 2 senior managers).

jenkins-bot: Meeting notes uploaded: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/People-Ops-Comp-Calibration-Notes-1769459876

Dmitri (EM): thanks — can we get a one-pager managers checklist for calibration? makes it easier to collect consistent packets.

Anika (People Ops): absolutely — checklist coming today. I'll drop it here and tag managers. Also setting up two office hours sessions next week for Q&A (Tue 10am PDT, Thu 4pm PDT) — sign-up link in the doc.

Tyler (Eng): appreciate it. last small ask: will we get visibility into total budget impact before final decisions? several of our teams plan hires around promos.

Maria (Comp & Benefits): managers will receive an estimated headcount/comp impact snapshot after calibration but before final approvals. We'll flag any blockers early.

Anika (People Ops): closing note: if you're a manager with one-off cases (comp exceptions, urgent retro promos), DM me and Maria directly. Posting the initial FAQ in the doc now, will update after office hours. :thumbsup:
